title: Escalation in drone strikes and jet‑powered attacks
rationale: Headlines: Russia/Ukraine ramp up jet‑powered drones; attacks hit refineries, buses, trains; NATO shot down drones.

title: Possible signature of US Russia sanctions bill
rationale: Headlines: House passes sweeping Russia sanctions; bill sent to Trump; targets importers of Russian oil.

title: EU €3.3bn missile and drone procurement
rationale: Headline: EU to disburse €3.3 billion to Ukraine to procure missiles and drones, von der Leyen says.

title: Ukrainian offensive push in northern Donetsk
rationale: Headline: Ukraine launches offensive push in north of Donetsk region, senior commander says.

title: Talks on an energy-targeted truce
rationale: Headlines: Trump claims energy truce; Ukraine open to halting attacks; Kremlin welcomes idea.

title: European procurement and rearmament acceleration
rationale: Headlines: EU funding for missiles/drones; Jaguar Land Rover targets NATO budgets; Europe demands bigger missile arsenals.

title: Sustained strikes on rail, bridges and export infrastructure
rationale: Headlines: Russia damages bridge crucial for grain exports; strikes on train, warehouses, petrol station.

title: Expanded U.S. diplomatic and intelligence engagement
rationale: Headlines: US spy chief preps greater role in talks; US envoy secures prisoner releases, expects more.

title: EU decision on six‑month sanctions renewal
rationale: Headline: EU envoys extend sanctions by seven days to debate six‑month renewal.
